_comment: Fast-engine settings, all in METRES and degrees whatever the project unit. The first seven carry the names of TerraScan's Ground routine settings. max_building_size: one starting point per square of this size; lower it (20 to 30) on hilly projects where buildings are already in their own class. steep_iteration_angle: used on steep ground (iteration_angle is used on flat ground). ground_band: points this close to the ground surface are ground too, at most one per 0.3 m square; 0 = surface points only. follow_surface: let the ground continue over hill tops, banks and ridges the plain routine cannot climb. remove_spikes: take single points that stand out of the surface back out.
